recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future FormatCode additions or display/definition corrections should be made through THO or IHE terminology maintenance rather than reintroducing an in-core value set.

additional_context: Later format-code decisions moved the hand-maintained core value set to external terminology management: FHIR-13950/FHIR-14003 moved toward IHE code-system publication and correct OID use, FHIR-14104/UP-241 established THO HL7FormatCodes, and git 6f1b3314e9 rebound DocumentReference to the THO value set and deleted the old core value set.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current active core source binds DocumentReference.content.profile.value[x] to http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v3-HL7FormatCodes, and the terminology dependency contains the requested codes and descriptions.
